description.value: The Outpost Board Game Café is a dedicated board-game café in Langford's Westshore area, home to the region's largest board game library where guests pay a flat play fee and can spend hours at the table. The kitchen turns out hearty sandwiches on artisan loaves, personal pizzas, all-day breakfast, and over-the-top milkshakes, alongside local craft beer, cider, and coffee. Regular weekly events—trivia nights, music bingo, and Beyblade battles—make it a lively community gathering spot that a cyclist looking for a long, restorative stop would enjoy.
